newsitem.title: USA: Q Lube signs deal with Discount Auto Parts.
newsitem.headline: Q Lube signs deal with Discount Auto Parts.

text.p: Q Lube Inc of Quaker State Corp and Discount Auto Parts Inc said on Monday they had signed a letter of intent to enter into a joint venture.
The companies said they would open centers that offer both the retail sale of automotive parts as well as lube and automotive maintenance services.
The new Q Lube centers will also offer engine diagnostic and a variety of automotive maintenance services such as cooling system and air conditioning services, they said.
The companies, which did not disclose the financial terms of their joint venture, said they would open the centers in Florida and other areas of the U.S. southeast by the end of next year.
